name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: No major cold wave or winter storm found on 11 Nov; Met Office says a weakening polar vortex raises later cold risk
state: Searches on 11 Nov found no top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region and no cold outbreak causing power or gas outages. The Met Office said on 7 Nov that a stratospheric warming was under way and could become the earliest major sudden stratospheric warming on record, raising the chance of UK cold later in November, though such events do not always bring cold (ITV News). That risk explains the upward trend.
for_you: No action needed now. A colder spell later in November is possible but not certain; check Met Office forecasts and warnings, and UKHSA cold-health alerts if temperatures drop.
rubric_hit: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations = Normal

sources.title: ITV News — UK faces increased risk of cold snap as polar vortex weakens

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
